atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(100, "Coil Lookback", 20, 200, 1)
vovLen = input(14, "Vol of Vol Length", 2, 60, 1)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 2, 60, 1)
releaseATRMult = input(1.5, "Release ATR Mult", 0.5, 4.0, 0.1)
coilThreshold = input(0.8, "Coil Threshold", 0.1, 0.95, 0.05)
predThreshold = input(0.5, "Predictability Threshold", 0.1, 0.9, 0.05)

tr = max(high - low, abs(high - close[1]), abs(low - close[1]))
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
rangeMA = sma(rng, atrLen)
highestATR = highest(atrVal, coilLookback)
highestRangeMA = highest(rangeMA, coilLookback)
coilATR = atrVal / max(highestATR, 0.000000001)
coilRng = rangeMA / max(highestRangeMA, 0.000000001)
coilLoad = 1 - (coilATR + coilRng) / 2
atrChg = (atrVal - atrVal[1]) / max(atrVal[1], 0.000000001)
vov = stdev(atrChg, vovLen)
highestVov = highest(vov, coilLookback)
volRise = vov / max(highestVov, 0.000000001)
sumTR = sma(tr, predLen) * predLen
pred = abs(close - close[predLen]) / max(sumTR, 0.000000001)
expansion = rng / max(atrVal, 0.000000001)
coiled = coilLoad > coilThreshold and volRise > 0.6
coiledPrior = coiled[1]
loadedUnpred = coilLoad > coilThreshold and pred < predThreshold
loadedPred = coilLoad > coilThreshold and pred >= predThreshold
unpredPlot = loadedUnpred and not loadedPred ? coilLoad : 0
predPlot = loadedPred ? coilLoad : 0
releaseLong = coiledPrior and rng > atrVal * releaseATRMult and close > open
releaseShort = coiledPrior and rng > atrVal * releaseATRMult and close < open
releaseAny = releaseLong or releaseShort

if releaseLong { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if releaseShort { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
bgcolor(releaseAny ? "#ff7a1a" : "#00000000")
plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
hline(coilThreshold, "#ffd43b")
plot(pred, "Tape Predictability", "#b48cff", 2, "separate")
hline(predThreshold, "#ff4477")
plot(expansion, "Expansion Range/ATR", "#ff7a1a", 1, "separate")
plot3d(expansion, "Expansion Z", "bars3d", "#ff7a1a", "separate", 0)
plot3d(unpredPlot, "Loaded Unpredictable", "scatter", "#6b7f99", "separate", 1)
plot3d(predPlot, "Loaded Predictable", "scatter", "#ff3b1a", "separate", 2)

kNeighbours = input(7, "K Neighbours", 1, 15, 1)
FeatureLen = input(20, "Feature Length", 5, 40, 1)
HistoryLibrary = input(300, "History Library", 50, 500, 10)
MarginThresh = input(0.42, "Margin Threshold", 0.1, 1.0, 0.01)
DisagreeThresh = input(0.35, "Disagree Threshold", 0.05, 1.0, 0.01)

varip fHist = array(0)
varip targetHist = array(0)
varip cacheM = 0.0
varip cacheD = 1.0

fRaw = (close - close[1]) / (close[1] + 0.0000001)
f = fRaw
if bar_index == 0 { f := 0.0 }

nHist = array.size(targetHist)
prevC = close
if nHist > 0 { prevC := targetHist[nHist - 1] }

dirNow = 0
if close > close[1] { dirNow := 1 }
if bar_index == 0 { dirNow := 0 }
if close <= close[1] { dirNow := 0 - 1 }

array.push(fHist, f)
array.push(targetHist, dirNow)

numBars = array.size(fHist)
ready = bar_index >= HistoryLibrary + FeatureLen + 5 and numBars > HistoryLibrary + FeatureLen + 5

margin = 0.0
margin := cacheM
disagreeNorm = 1.0
disagreeNorm := cacheD

if ready {
    bestD0 = 999999.0
    bestD1 = 999999.0
    bestD2 = 999999.0
    bestD3 = 999999.0
    bestD4 = 999999.0
    bestD5 = 999999.0
    bestD6 = 999999.0
    bestT0 = 0
    bestT1 = 0
    bestT2 = 0
    bestT3 = 0
    bestT4 = 0
    bestT5 = 0
    bestT6 = 0

    libMax = HistoryLibrary
    if numBars - FeatureLen - 2 < libMax { libMax := numBars - FeatureLen - 2 }

    i = 21
    while i <= libMax {
        dist2 = 0.0
        j = 0
        while j < FeatureLen {
            curV = fHist[numBars - 1 - j]
            pastV = fHist[numBars - 1 - i - j]
            diff = curV - pastV
            dist2 := dist2 + diff * diff
            j := j + 1
        }
        dist = sqrt(dist2)
        labIdx = numBars - i
        lab = targetHist[labIdx]
        if dist < bestD6 {
            if dist < bestD0 {
                bestD6 := bestD5
                bestT6 := bestT5
                bestD5 := bestD4
                bestT5 := bestT4
                bestD4 := bestD3
                bestT4 := bestT3
                bestD3 := bestD2
                bestT3 := bestT2
                bestD2 := bestD1
                bestT2 := bestT1
                bestD1 := bestD0
                bestT1 := bestT0
                bestD0 := dist
                bestT0 := lab
            } else {
                if dist < bestD1 {
                    bestD6 := bestD5
                    bestT6 := bestT5
                    bestD5 := bestD4
                    bestT5 := bestT4
                    bestD4 := bestD3
                    bestT4 := bestT3
                    bestD3 := bestD2
                    bestT3 := bestT2
                    bestD2 := bestD1
                    bestT2 := bestT1
                    bestD1 := dist
                    bestT1 := lab
                } else {
                    if dist < bestD2 {
                        bestD6 := bestD5
                        bestT6 := bestT5
                        bestD5 := bestD4
                        bestT5 := bestT4
                        bestD4 := bestD3
                        bestT4 := bestT3
                        bestD3 := bestD2
                        bestT3 := bestT2
                        bestD2 := dist
                        bestT2 := lab
                    } else {
                        if dist < bestD3 {
                            bestD6 := bestD5
                            bestT6 := bestT5
                            bestD5 := bestD4
                            bestT5 := bestT4
                            bestD4 := bestD3
                            bestT4 := bestT3
                            bestD3 := dist
                            bestT3 := lab
                        } else {
                            if dist < bestD4 {
                                bestD6 := bestD5
                                bestT6 := bestT5
                                bestD5 := bestD4
                                bestT5 := bestT4
                                bestD4 := dist
                                bestT4 := lab
                            } else {
                                if dist < bestD5 {
                                    bestD6 := bestD5
                                    bestT6 := bestT5
                                    bestD5 := dist
                                    bestT5 := lab
                                } else {
                                    bestD6 := dist
                                    bestT6 := lab
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        i := i + 1
    }

    bullVotes = 0
    if bestT0 == 1 { bullVotes := bullVotes + 1 }
    if bestT1 == 1 { bullVotes := bullVotes + 1 }
    if bestT2 == 1 { bullVotes := bullVotes + 1 }
    if bestT3 == 1 { bullVotes := bullVotes + 1 }
    if bestT4 == 1 { bullVotes := bullVotes + 1 }
    if bestT5 == 1 { bullVotes := bullVotes + 1 }
    if bestT6 == 1 { bullVotes := bullVotes + 1 }
    bearVotes = kNeighbours - bullVotes

    mVal = (bullVotes - bearVotes) / 7.0
    meanD = (bestD0 + bestD1 + bestD2 + bestD3 + bestD4 + bestD5 + bestD6) / 7.0
    vSum = (bestD0 - meanD) * (bestD0 - meanD) + (bestD1 - meanD) * (bestD1 - meanD) + (bestD2 - meanD) * (bestD2 - meanD) + (bestD3 - meanD) * (bestD3 - meanD) + (bestD4 - meanD) * (bestD4 - meanD) + (bestD5 - meanD) * (bestD5 - meanD) + (bestD6 - meanD) * (bestD6 - meanD)
    sdD = sqrt(vSum / 7.0)
    dRaw = sdD / (meanD + 0.0001)
    dClip = dRaw
    if dClip < 0.0 { dClip := 0.0 }
    if dClip > 2.0 { dClip := 2.0 }
    dVal = dClip / 2.0

    margin := mVal
    disagreeNorm := dVal
    cacheM := mVal
    cacheD := dVal
}

crispness = abs(margin) * (1.0 - disagreeNorm)

prevM = margin[1]
prevD = disagreeNorm[1]
buySig = ready and margin > MarginThresh and disagreeNorm < DisagreeThresh and (prevM <= MarginThresh or prevD >= DisagreeThresh)

sessLen = input(20, "Session Length", 10, 500, 1)
structLb = input(3, "Structure Lookback", 1, 10, 1)
stopOff = input(10.0, "Stop Offset", 0.5, 100.0, 0.5)
minQ = input(2, "Min Structure Quality", 0, 3, 1)
sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
sessMid = (sessHigh + sessLow) / 2
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHighPrev = htfHigh[1]
htfLowPrev = htfLow[1]
priorHigh = highest(htfHighPrev, structLb)
priorLow = lowest(htfLowPrev, structLb)
isSwingHigh = htfHigh > priorHigh
isSwingLow = htfLow < priorLow
var lastSH = 0.0
var prevSH = 0.0
var lastSL = 0.0
var prevSL = 0.0
var entryPx = 0.0
var posState = 0
if isSwingHigh {
    prevSH := lastSH
    lastSH := htfHigh
}
if isSwingLow {
    prevSL := lastSL
    lastSL := htfLow
}
bullBias = lastSH > prevSH and lastSL > prevSL and lastSH > 0 and lastSL > 0
bearBias = lastSH < prevSH and lastSL < prevSL and lastSH > 0 and lastSL > 0
neutral = not bullBias and not bearBias
q1 = neutral ? 0 : 1
q2bull = bullBias and htfClose > lastSH ? 1 : 0
q2bear = bearBias and htfClose < lastSL ? 1 : 0
q2 = bullBias ? q2bull : q2bear
q3bull = bullBias and close > sessMid ? 1 : 0
q3bear = bearBias and close < sessMid ? 1 : 0
q3 = bullBias ? q3bull : q3bear
quality = q1 + q2 + q3
conf = quality / 3
sessHighPrev = sessHigh[1]
sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]
breakHigh = close > sessHighPrev
breakLow = close < sessLowPrev
buySig = breakHigh and bullBias and quality >= minQ and posState != 1
sellSig = breakLow and bearBias and quality >= minQ and posState != -1
longStopHit = posState == 1 and close <= entryPx - stopOff
shortStopHit = posState == -1 and close >= entryPx + stopOff
longStopExit = posState == 1 and longStopHit and not buySig
shortStopExit = posState == -1 and shortStopHit and not sellSig
if buySig {
    model.confidence(conf)
    model.stopLoss(stopOff, "abs")
    model.shortExit("siege")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    entryPx := close
    posState := 1
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(conf)
    model.stopLoss(stopOff, "abs")
    model.longExit("siege")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    entryPx := close
    posState := -1
}
if longStopExit {
    model.exit("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit Long", "xcross", "#ffcc00")
    posState := 0
}
if shortStopExit {
    model.exit("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit Short", "xcross", "#ffcc00")
    posState := 0
}
plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
